definitions.content: Absorbance divided by the optical pathlength b and the amount of substance concentration c.

notes.content: The derived SI unit is the square metre per mole (m^2/mol), but the litre per mole per mm (L/(mol·mm) or litre per mole per cm (L/(mol·cm) is often used.
The specific molar absorption coefficient slightly depends on the amount of substance concentration.
